fusions.name: Trampling Rush
fusions.desc: Tramples through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Yokebreaker
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wind-up, a blow that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Plodding Wrath
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 20% for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Mounting Grudge
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (48% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
